spans.s:
अबोध m. (-धः) Ignorance, stupidity.
 mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
 1. Ignorant, stupid.
2. Puzzled, perplexed.
 E. अ neg. बोध knowledge.

अबोधगम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) Incomprehensible.
 E. अ neg. बोध knowledge,
गम्य to be attained by.

अबोधनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
 1. Unintelligible.
 2. Not to be awakened or
aroused.
 E. अ neg. बोधनीय to be understood, &c. also अबोधितव्य and
अबोध्य.

आबोधन n. (-नं)
 1. Knowledge, understanding.
 2. Instructing, inform-
ing.
 E. आङ् before बुद्ध to know, causal, form, ल्युट् aff.
